t: 加尼耶宫是世界上最出名的歌剧院之一,在巴黎落成.
te: The Palais Garnier, one of the most famous opera houses in the world, is inaugurated in Paris.
dz: 加尼耶宫是世界上最出名的歌剧院之一,在巴黎落成.
de: The Palais Garnier, one of the most famous opera houses in the world, is inaugurated in Paris.

t: 党卫军哥德堡号命中了大堡礁并沉入澳大利亚东海岸外,造成约100人死亡,其中包括多位高官和要人.
te: The SS Gothenburg hits the Great Barrier Reef and sinks off the Australian east coast, killing approximately 100, inclu…
dz: 党卫军哥德堡号命中了大堡礁并沉入澳大利亚东海岸外,造成约100人死亡,其中包括多位高官和要人.
de: The SS Gothenburg hits the Great Barrier Reef and sinks off the Australian east coast, killing approximately 100, including a number of high-profile civil servants and dignitaries.

t: 中国清朝光绪皇帝在慈禧太后摄政下开始统治。
te: Guangxu Emperor of Qing dynasty China begins his reign, under Empress Dowager Cixi's regency.
dz: 中国清朝光绪皇帝在慈禧太后摄政下开始统治。
de: Guangxu Emperor of Qing dynasty China begins his reign, under Empress Dowager Cixi's regency.

t: 纽约大主教约翰·麦克洛斯基被命名为美国第一位红衣主教.
te: Archbishop of New York John McCloskey is named the first cardinal in the United States.
dz: 纽约大主教约翰·麦克洛斯基被命名为美国第一位红衣主教.
de: Archbishop of New York John McCloskey is named the first cardinal in the United States.

t: 阿里斯蒂德斯凭借骑师奥利弗·刘易斯(2:37.75)赢得了肯塔基州首个德比.
te: Aristides wins the first Kentucky Derby with the jockey Oliver Lewis (2:37.75).
dz: 阿里斯蒂德斯凭借骑师奥利弗·刘易斯(2:37.75)赢得了肯塔基州首个德比.
de: Aristides wins the first Kentucky Derby with the jockey Oliver Lewis (2:37.75).

t: 由17个国家签署《梅特雷公约》,导致建立国际单位制度.
te: Signing of the Metre Convention by 17 nations leading to the establishment of the International System of Units.
dz: 由17个国家签署《梅特雷公约》,导致建立国际单位制度.
de: Signing of the Metre Convention by 17 nations leading to the establishment of the International System of Units.

t: 赫泽戈维尼亚人反抗奥斯曼帝国的叛乱开始.
te: The Herzegovinian rebellion against the Ottoman Empire begins.
dz: 赫泽戈维尼亚人反抗奥斯曼帝国的叛乱开始.
de: The Herzegovinian rebellion against the Ottoman Empire begins.

t: 反对奥斯曼统治的克塞哥维纳起义开始,这场起义将持续到1878年并在整个巴尔干地区产生深远影响.
te: The Herzegovina Uprising against Ottoman rule begins, which would last until 1878 and have far-reaching implications th…
dz: 反对奥斯曼统治的克塞哥维纳起义开始,这场起义将持续到1878年并在整个巴尔干地区产生深远影响.
de: The Herzegovina Uprising against Ottoman rule begins, which would last until 1878 and have far-reaching implications throughout the Balkans.

t: 日本和俄罗斯之间的"圣彼得堡条约"得到批准,规定将萨哈林换入库里尔群岛.
te: The Treaty of Saint Petersburg between Japan and Russia is ratified, providing for the exchange of Sakhalin for the Kur…
dz: 日本和俄罗斯之间的"圣彼得堡条约"得到批准,规定将萨哈林换入库里尔群岛.
de: The Treaty of Saint Petersburg between Japan and Russia is ratified, providing for the exchange of Sakhalin for the Kuril Islands.

t: 马修·韦伯船长成为第一个穿越英吉利海峡出道的人,在21小时45分后从英国多佛到法国加来.
te: Captain Matthew Webb becomes the first person to swim across the English Channel, traveling from Dover, England, to Cal…
dz: 马修·韦伯船长成为第一个穿越英吉利海峡出道的人,在21小时45分后从英国多佛到法国加来.
de: Captain Matthew Webb becomes the first person to swim across the English Channel, traveling from Dover, England, to Calais, France, in 21 hours and 45 minutes.

t: 1864年出演了由Aleksis Kivi在芬兰奥卢首演的希斯·科布尔斯.
te: The 1864 play Heath Cobblers by Aleksis Kivi premieres in Oulu, Finland.
dz: 1864年出演了由Aleksis Kivi在芬兰奥卢首演的希斯·科布尔斯.
de: The 1864 play Heath Cobblers by Aleksis Kivi premieres in Oulu, Finland.

t: 商船埃伦·索塔尔号在利物浦被狂风所撞倒.
te: The merchant sailing ship Ellen Southard is wrecked in a storm at Liverpool.
dz: 商船埃伦·索塔尔号在利物浦被狂风所撞倒.
de: The merchant sailing ship Ellen Southard is wrecked in a storm at Liverpool.

t: 布里格姆青年大学成立于犹他州普罗沃.
te: Brigham Young University is founded in Provo, Utah.
dz: 布里格姆青年大学成立于犹他州普罗沃.
de: Brigham Young University is founded in Provo, Utah.

t: 彼得·伊里奇·柴可夫斯基 B♭ 小调第一钢琴协奏曲，作品。 23日在马萨诸塞州波士顿首演，由本…
te: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 in B♭ minor, Op. 23 premieres in Boston, Massachusetts, with Benjamin J…
dz: 彼得·伊里奇·柴可夫斯基 B♭ 小调第一钢琴协奏曲，作品。 23日在马萨诸塞州波士顿首演，由本杰明·约翰逊·朗担任指挥，汉斯·冯·比洛担任独奏家。
de: Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Piano Concerto No. 1 in B♭ minor, Op. 23 premieres in Boston, Massachusetts, with Benjamin Johnson Lang as conductor and Hans von Bülow as soloist.

t: 臭名昭著的纽约市政治家Boss Tweed出狱;后来他在西班牙被收复.
te: Notorious New York City politician Boss Tweed escapes from prison; he is later recaptured in Spain.
dz: 臭名昭著的纽约市政治家Boss Tweed出狱;后来他在西班牙被收复.
de: Notorious New York City politician Boss Tweed escapes from prison; he is later recaptured in Spain.
